capabilities.justification: The CLI passes the reusable Go microbenchmark monotonic clock to the collector.
On Windows, the transitive microbenchmark clock resolves the fixed high-resolution performance-counter APIs from kernel32.dll.
On Windows, the transitive microbenchmark clock calls the fixed QueryPerformanceCounter and QueryPerformanceFrequency APIs.
The CLI writes its JSON report and diagnostic/help output to standard output streams.

justification: The program parses argv, collects timings with the shared monotonic clock, and writes a JSON result or CLI diagnostics to standard streams. Its seeded math/rand input is deterministic; the shipped path does not access files, spawn processes, use networking, or read environment variables.
